Cold War pocket change — light as foil, used by the millions in shops under the planned economy. Aluminum honesty: almost no melt, all history. Sole Hungary flip · SER EU-HU-001. Hungary flips now 1.
C032.story: A 1967 Hungarian 1-forint coin. The front shows the arms of the People's Republic of Hungary, with wheat and a star; the back shows a large 1 FORINT and the Budapest mint mark BP. Struck in aluminium.
